project_type: Kotlin-native Android app using Jetpack Compose + Supabase backend
build_system: Gradle with AGP 8.7.2, KSP for Room, Kotlin 2.0.21, compileSdk 34
test_framework: JUnit 4 + Espresso + Compose UI Test (minimal tests)
build_command: Cannot build locally (no Android SDK). CI runs: ./gradlew assembleDebug
test_command: Cannot run locally. Verify by code correctness and AST consistency.
verification_instructions: Verify all Kotlin files compile correctly by checking import consistency, class references, and ensuring no dangling references to removed components.
setup_instructions: Project is already set up. No local build possible due to network restrictions.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - no external downloads, no Android SDK, no Gradle build. All verification by code inspection only. CI will build on push.
contribution_requirements: Push to Rexo-Kotlin branch. CI workflow runs on push to Rexo-Kotlin. Supabase secrets configured in GitHub Secrets.
key_patterns: Repositories use SupabaseClient.client.from(tableName).select()/insert()/update()/delete(). DTOs are @Serializable data classes. ViewModels use StateFlow. Screens are @Composable functions. Navigation via NavGraph.kt with sealed Screen classes and FloatingPillBottomNavigation.
directory_structure: app/src/main/java/com/rexo/marketplace/ - Main package. data/ (model, remote, repository, local), navigation/ (NavGraph.kt), ui/ (screens/, viewmodel/, theme/), services/. Screens: admin, auth, campaigns, chat, home, notifications, profile, services, settings, shop, splash, wallet.
